got-fetch npm Package Hijacked (Scavenger Malware)

Target: got-fetch
Repository: https://github.com/sindresorhus/got-fetch
Date: 2025-07-18 to 2025-07-22 (4 days)
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Data Exfiltration/Remote Access
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Remote Access/Credential Theft
User Impact: 0
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

As part of an expanding supply chain attack tied to the npnjs.com phishing campaign, attackers published rogue versions of got-fetch. The malware, dubbed Scavenger, stole browser data and credentials, and provided remote access via WebSocket.

Compromised Versions

  • 5.1.11
  • 5.1.12

References

  • https://socket.dev/blog/npm-is-package-hijacked-in-expanding-supply-chain-attack
